what: Stop branch introduces SUMMARY_OUTCOME=cancelled-assessor-worse but the plan does not update the enforced outcome enum
scenario_or_breakage: Operator chooses Stop after a WORSE verdict; the Final summary block calls render-final-summary.sh --outcome cancelled-assessor-worse and exits 2 instead of producing the intended clean cancelled summary
suggested_fix: Add cancelled-assessor-worse to render-final-summary.sh and its tests; do not rely only on SKILL.md prose enumeration

what: Cursor increment is planned only for Gate C(c), but Gate B/Gate C discussion re-entry can also return to Step 3
scenario_or_breakage: HARD user picks Switch to discussion mode or Discuss further, then Ready for review; Step 3 reruns with the old cursor, round artifacts are overwritten or stale, and the assessor does not fire as a new round
suggested_fix: Centralize round advancement for every post-plan re-entry to Step 3, or explicitly increment the cursor on Gate B(c) and Gate C(b) Gate A exits as well as Gate C(c)

what: Tally rule conflicts with its own edge cases: successful==3 and worse_count > better_count makes one WORSE plus two TIE votes a WORSE majority
scenario_or_breakage: The planned edge case says 0 BETTER + 2 TIE + 1 WORSE must be NOT_WORSE, but implementing the stated rule would trigger the Continue/Stop prompt
suggested_fix: Define WORSE as a strict majority of successful assessors: 3 successful requires worse_count >= 2, 2 successful requires worse_count == 2, 1 successful requires worse_count == 1; update assessor.md and tests to match

what: Plan adds base assessor timing kinds but dispatch-with-waterfall has no timing-kind override and synthesizes phase-qualified task kinds
scenario_or_breakage: If dispatch-plan-assessors passes --timing-task-kind as planned, waterfall exits on unknown option; if it does not, records use unallowlisted codex-phase1-* / cursor-phase1-* kinds instead of codex-plan-assessor / cursor-plan-assessor
suggested_fix: Extend dispatch-with-waterfall to accept per-slot timing_task_kind or add the actual synthesized assessor task kinds to the allowlist and structural tests
